mapper.select: WITH catalog AS ( SELECT lower(trim(dict_value)) AS v, lower(trim(dict_label)) AS lab, lower(trim(COALESCE(dict_label_en, ''))) AS lab_en, lower(trim(COALESCE(dict_label_th, ''))) AS lab_th FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = 'crm_tag' ), entity_tags AS ( SELECT e->>'id' AS id, e->>'text' AS text FROM crm_contact c, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(c.tag, '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array' THEN c.tag ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) e UNION ALL SELECT e->>'id' AS id, e->>'text' AS text FROM crm_lead l, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(l.tag, '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array' THEN l.tag ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) e ) SELECT et.id, et.text, COUNT(*)::bigint AS count FROM entity_tags et WHERE et.id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(et.id) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog c WHERE c.v = lower(trim(et.id)) OR (et.text IS NOT NULL AND btrim(et.text) <> '' AND ( c.lab = lower(trim(et.text)) OR (c.lab_en <> '' AND c.lab_en = lower(trim(et.text))) OR (c.lab_th <> '' AND c.lab_th = lower(trim(et.text))) )) ) GROUP BY et.id, et.text ORDER BY count DESC, et.id, et.text
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_contact c WHERE crm_tag_ids(c.tag::text) @> ARRAY[#{dictValue}]::text[]

SELECT 'contact' AS entity, c.contact_id AS id, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(c.lead_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c.name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c.wecom_name), ''), c.contact_id ) AS name, c.mobile_phone AS mobile_phone FROM crm_contact c WHERE crm_tag_ids(c.tag::text) @> ARRAY[#{dictValue}]::text[] ORDER BY c.contact_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead l WHERE crm_tag_ids(l.tag::text) @> ARRAY[#{dictValue}]::text[]

SELECT 'lead' AS entity, l.lead_id::text AS id, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(l.lead_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.full_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.contact_name), ''), l.lead_id::text ) AS name, l.mobile_phone AS mobile_phone FROM crm_lead l WHERE crm_tag_ids(l.tag::text) @> ARRAY[#{dictValue}]::text[] ORDER BY l.lead_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.contact_id FROM crm_contact c WHERE c.tag IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.tag) = 'array' THEN c.tag ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) e WHERE (#{fromId} IS NOT NULL AND #{fromId} <> '' AND e->>'id' = #{fromId}) OR (#{fromText} IS NOT NULL AND #{fromText} <> '' AND e->>'text' = #{fromText}) ) ORDER BY c.contact_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.lead_id FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.tag IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.tag) = 'array' THEN l.tag ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) e WHERE (#{fromId} IS NOT NULL AND #{fromId} <> '' AND e->>'id' = #{fromId}) OR (#{fromText} IS NOT NULL AND #{fromText} <> '' AND e->>'text' = #{fromText}) ) ORDER BY l.lead_id LIMIT #{limit}

#{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_tag_channel_mapping ( dict_value, channel, channel_tag_id, channel_tag_name, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{dictValue}, #{channel}, #{channelTagId}, #{channelTagName}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (dict_value, channel) DO UPDATE SET channel_tag_id = EXCLUDED.channel_tag_id, channel_tag_name = EXCLUDED.channel_tag_name, status = EXCLUDED.status, update_by = EXCLUDED.update_by, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
